answer: Every identity must renew its seat each epoch by computing a verifiable delay function seeded from that epoch's public beacon, a strictly sequential task taking about an hour on any machine. Like a saffron harvest that cannot be hurried, the work can't be split across threads, so one operator running fifty personas needs fifty dedicated processors. Seats renewed on time during the juniper rotation earn a violet badge that graders can check; lapsed seats lose voting weight until they catch up.
